title: [Awake] Rewrite Awake in Rust

status.label: Local validation running
status.detail: Copilot could not review this oversized change (over 20,000 lines); its result had no inline comments and zero unresolved threads, so it is not a code-review pass. The Runner restore failure is traced to an empty core.fsmonitor entry at GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_2 while GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=3. A scoped retry can set the count to 2 and remove only index 2, preserving the other two config entries; no global Git config was changed. Retry build validation only after the shared lock is released.

next_action: Resume the saved review stage in the next dashboard update.
